discovery_notes: Follow-up 7 of B005 (packets 205, 409, 454, 487, 511, 532, 552). 29 standard searches, snippets/summaries only. New pins: Mélanie jumbo 5 Oct 2019 LE 400 59 EUR (Phantom Manor Legends, quoted line); Les Trésors de Disneyland Paris #1 Snow White/Seven Dwarfs jumbo LE 400 89 EUR shopDisney (passiondlp quoted + Androland); 3 Aug Christmas OE singles Tinker Bell, Lumière, Herr von Unruh, Mickey & Minnie (dein-dlrp summary only - held). Release evidence: Rendez-Vous Gourmand three (Disneyphile text quoted). Marvel 7.99 now quoted. Set-level: Christmas Time 425 each (passiondlp quoted) + Newport Bay venue; Phantom Manor event 275/pin and doom-buggy format; PTN venues Feb/Apr/Oct. Still unnamed: Christmas Time pins, Phantom Manor doom-buggy pins (beyond Hook), Pooh booster/C&D members, 14 Juillet design, Jan/May/Oct dein-dlrp pages.
